trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. Nothing here needs multiplayer, DLC, or a second playthrough. On Xbox the same milestone is the Mythic achievement.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It ends on its own as the story moves forward — there is no extra objective to chase.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The asterisks are part of the official name as PlayStation lists it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. Free roam keeps going after the credits, so nothing is locked behind it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is part of the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is part of the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is part of the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It is part of the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It is part of the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is part of the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It asks for 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, all 39 illegal operations, all 8 bank vaults, and Bret's 15 target decks. This is the biggest single grind in the game.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights, and 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one. Find stunt spots on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots; check your count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt. One try each is enough — you do not need to win any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions. Track them under Activities, then Shooting Ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some races charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Track them under Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 DIFFERENT races. Repeating the same race does not count. Most race locations let you hire a car, and a car's Rating matters — raise it with Mod Shop upgrades. Track wins under Activities, then Racing.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal texts you a fishing spot after you meet him in Chapter 1. Catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg; you will need a boat with a fishing rod — hijack one if you have to.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any in-game video game through to the end. Three of them run on the TV at home, and a fourth sits on arcade machines.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. Lucia only. It starts with a phone call in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand, all seven shipwrecks. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back later, so this is not missable. The final mission is Maritime Disputes.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2, and the final mission is Hometown Heroes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger mission strands. Only some side questlines count, and which ones is still being confirmed — do the strands as they appear and check your count. This can be finished after the story, and it is not part of 100% completion.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down labs in Vice City. Jason only, from Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. A spot only counts once the final zen animation plays. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations; the map lists them under Exploration, then Meditate Around Leonida. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: one morning meditation in Chapter 1 at Jason's house — Lucia meditates on the balcony, follow her and accept the optional quest — is gone after Chapter 1. PowerPyx flags it; Push Square lists no missables; it is not clear whether the trophy needs that one morning, since it is not marked as a spot like the other 18. Do it when it comes up.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason only, from Chapter 2. Which animal triggers it is UNCONFIRMED. Clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks — which 100% completion needs anyway — should cover it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets; 100% needs 15. Cards can be sold at pawn shops and still count. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app — hold Up to open it. The pool is 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 in-game challenges; 100% needs 70. Track them under Progress, then Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner along, then escape. This works once both characters can roam together, from Chapter 2. Bank jobs give 4 stars anyway.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing the wanted level. It pops about 30 seconds after the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough — you do not have to drive them. 100% needs 200 of 277. Track them under Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Gang members count; soldiers, police and civilians seem not to.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They have been found at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. There are 8 vaults, and 100% needs all 8. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4. Grade note: Push Square lists this as Bronze; the starter list, Insider Gaming and sixshore all say Silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is the fastest way.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and 100% needs all 39.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published for this one yet. Do not chase rumours; check back once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published for this one yet. Do not chase rumours; check back once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress. Note: Push Square does not mark this one as hidden.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It comes naturally over a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published yet. PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store, but that is a suspicion, not a confirmed method. Do not chase it as fact.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published yet. PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline, but that is a suspicion, not a confirmed method.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle — but neither is confirmed. Do not chase it as fact.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through fences and contacts. It adds up across robberies. The dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. The total is about $160,000. The real estate app arrives in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first — pair it with Little Boxes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
